## MMM_MODEL_SPECIFICATION_AND_LEVEL_SCALE_SEMANTICS_AUDIT_001 — implementation evidence

- Completed the source-traceable audit and archived deterministic research evidence for the H6 retail full-controls pilot (20 geos × 52 weeks × 7 channels).
- Confirmed production Ridge is one global intercept plus pooled transformed media coefficients and supplied controls; geo/week are ordering/state dimensions, not automatic mean effects. Ridge returns plain `exp(mu)` with no smearing correction. The Bayesian comparator uses `exp(mu + 0.5*sigma^2)` but remains research-only.
- Confirmed canonical planning computes row-level `exp(mu)` before level aggregation; no canonical `exp(mean(mu))` implementation defect was found. Full-panel Delta-mu remains the canonical decision quantity.
- Empirical evidence: plain exponentiation relative level bias `-8.58%`; global lognormal correction `-0.24%`; global Duan smearing `-0.17%`; geo smearing range `0.570–2.054`; near-national TV within-week variation ratio `0.00437`; exact-national plus saturated-week design rank deficiency; 40 seeded plan rank correlations `0.99981` (global correction) and `0.99962` (geo correction).
- Recommendations are classified and staged in the audit: diagnostic identification/residual hardening is supported; geo/time structure, retransformation, replay, geo-varying effects, and broader Delta-mu equivalence require more evidence; no production fix was implemented.
- H6/H6f scope and prior-validation blind spots are documented. Existing H6 artifacts remain diagnostic-only; no CalibrationSignal, TrustReport, replay, optimizer, economics, production default, contract, MIP, or GeoX behavior changed.
- Focused deterministic Docker evidence commands, JSON archive, documentation validation, taskctl lifecycle checks, diff checks, and the mandatory Docker-backed `make validate` are required before review freeze.
- Unresolved execution-blocking design questions: none.
